purpose: Manual verified case-study observations used to define CEX/Futures revival patterns. These are learning examples, not live market feeds or backfilled trade calls.

learning: large price acceleration with positive funding
require spot/volume/OI confirmation before treating as healthy revival
rising positive funding increases late-long crowding risk
do not credit pre-detection price appreciation to Wallet500
price rising while funding is deeply negative is a squeeze divergence
extreme negative funding should increase squeeze score, not be treated as bearish by itself
confirm with volume/OI acceleration and spot participation
flag concentration/manipulation risk separately from squeeze opportunity
large price breakout with near-neutral funding can be spot-led or broad-demand revival
near-neutral funding means squeeze is not sufficient explanation
require volume/OI/spot confirmation and event discovery
cross-chain CEX radar must not be limited to Solana Ethereum and BNB
